verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Xero publishes its own official MCP server (xero-mcp-server) so external AI agents can call Xero's tools, but there is no evidence that Xero itself acts as an MCP client/host that lets users plug in external MCP servers for Xero to consume their tools — the direction is reversed from what the story asks. missing for 10: any documentation of Xero's AI features (e.g. JAX) supporting incoming MCP server connections or a client-side MCP integration point.
